turns.content: My closest friend from college has canceled on me four times in a row. The reasons are always real, but I've started to feel like I'm the only one keeping this going. I don't know whether to say something or just let it quietly become a birthday-text friendship.
You feel frustrated. You already know you want a more reliable friendship. You do want to say something.
I drafted a message asking if everything's okay between us and then deleted it because it felt needy.
You want a clear answer. You do send the message. That is true.
Part of me thinks if the friendship mattered enough she'd already be showing up, and I shouldn't have to ask.
You want her to show up. You already know what you want. You do stop waiting.
We're supposed to get dinner next month. I keep thinking I'll just wait and see if she cancels again, and let that be my answer.
You want clarity now. You do not wait. You tell her how you feel.
